description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeePictureService class, which provides functionalities for managing employee pictures, including saving, retrieving, resizing, and cache management of employee pictures in a Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: EmployeePictureService
classes.description: Service class providing operations related to employee pictures, including storage, retrieval, resizing, cache management, and access control.

methods.name: getEmployeePictureDao
methods.description: Returns the EmployeePictureDao instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: pictureSizeAdjust
methods.description: Adjusts the size of a picture to a maximum of 200x200 pixels while maintaining aspect ratio.

methods.name: saveEmployeePicture
methods.description: Saves an employee picture to the database.

methods.name: getEmpPictureByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee's picture by employee number.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmpPictureByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee's picture if the current user has access rights.

methods.name: getEmpPictureETagByEmpNumber
methods.description: Gets the ETag for the employee's picture, used for cache validation.

methods.name: deleteEmpPictureETagByEmpNumber
methods.description: Deletes the cached ETag for an employee's picture.

methods.name: getEmpPictureETagAlongWithCache
methods.description: Generates and caches the ETag associated with an employee picture.

methods.name: generateEmpPictureETagCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key for storing the employee picture's ETag.
